images.title: A parallel line through B
images.purpose: Show a line through B parallel to m, made by copying the corresponding angle at A.
images.composition: A horizontal line m near the bottom, a slanted transversal l, and the new line n near the top.
exact_structure: A long horizontal dark line near the bottom, labelled m.
A point B above m, labelled B; a dark slanted line l through B that cuts m at A, labelled A and l.
At A, a grey (#6B7280) arc cutting m at C and l at D, with a dashed amber (#E69F00) chord CD; labels C and D.
At B, a grey (#6B7280) arc of the same radius cutting l; a small amber (#E69F00) arc of radius CD cutting it at E; label E.
A teal (#0072B2) line n through B and E, parallel to m, labelled n.
Two small reddish purple (#CC79A7) angle arcs of the same size: one at A between m and l, one at B between n and l, both labelled a.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Equal corresponding angles at A and B make n parallel to m.

image_decisions.why: The corresponding angles must be seen in position for the parallel argument.
